digest.component_or_area: generated doc/config surfaces and drift-gate infrastructure
propositions: Two JSON derived artifacts (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying banners, causing implementers to edit generated files instead of sources and fail drift gates repeatedly
Nine total derived/parity-gated surfaces exist across the codebase; five already carry banners but two JSON files cannot use comment syntax and remain unmarked
A fixed-point generator-emitted `_generated_by` marker must survive byte-identically through regeneration without stripping to pass drift gates
load_catalog() must skip underscore-prefixed keys so the reserved `_generated_by` marker never becomes a phantom reviewer or catalog entry
Existing on-disk equality tests (test_index_on_disk_matches_regenerated, test_user_write_does_not_change_committed_index) must be re-pointed from pure builder to marker-bearing document shape
A unified docs/README.md table must list all nine derived surfaces with regenerate commands and gates, while explicitly flagging three hand-authored-but-gated surfaces as NOT to be bannered
